method: Direct visual inspection of SVG-rasterized local PNG files at native size and 4x nearest-neighbour scale.
observations: All 57 assets are present in the intended row-major order.
Sign motifs, furniture silhouettes and material groups remain distinguishable on both light and dark grounds.
No clipped art, stray gutter pixels or fractional-edge antialiasing observed.
Floor repeats show no unintended transparent breaks across the 3x3 assemblies.
limitations: Static images only. Unity integration acceptance is a separate main-thread report in integration_validation.json.
